title: M13 — Observability — Baseline
description: Tour the three built-in signals on a healthy fleet: the event stream (type/reason/count, field-selector surveys), container logs (--tail/--since/-c/--previous and the stdout contract), resource metrics (kubectl top), and a healthy application-metrics target (a /metrics exposition endpoint with prometheus.io scrape annotations).
